definition.true_accel: Savitzky-Golay derivative (0.55 s, quadratic) of GT speed on a 20 Hz grid, repeated MORAI frames removed
definition.episode: a >= 0.3 m/s^2 (or <= -0.3), merged gaps <= 0.3 s, duration >= 0.8 s, |dv| >= 0.8 m/s; onset = foot where |a| <= 0.1
definition.spawn_episode: accel episode starting <= 1.5 s after a track first appears (track appeared > 0.5 s after bag start)
definition.highway_npc: assigned to a lane CSV (|d| <= 1.9 m) for >= 2 s
definition.relevant: GT lane == ego target lane, ds in [-120, +100] m, during LC attempt [t0-2 s, end] or lane-end wait (v<0.5, dist_to_end<=60 m)

all_highway.object_topic_range_note: NPCs enter/leave /Object_topic at ~300 m from the ego

M4_mode_detection.object_topic_mode_note: target_selector objectCallback publishes once per /Object_topic message (queue 1), v_long = npc.velocity.x/3.6, header = Object_topic header; so the filter would update at the Object_topic rate. NOTE: Object_topic positions are MORAI-local, /odom and lane CSVs are UTM (offset ~(302595.0, 4124145.0) m); baseline objectCallback applies no offset.
